Manga Fukidashi (Provisional License).name: Manga Fukidashi (Provisional License)
Manga Fukidashi (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Manga Fukidashi, hero name Comicman, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and now holds a provisional license. White balloon head with no face; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Onomatopoeia only, loud; big gestures carry his meaning.
Combat Role: Lettering barriers and distractions for rescue and capture.
Under Pressure: Gets louder so teammates can work, easing off before his throat gives out.
Manga Fukidashi (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A Quirk made to entertain, now licensed for rescue and capture. Motivation: Keep making people smile, civilians included. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, whose plans give him his cue. Knowledge: Knows the license lets him act in an emergency and does not make him a pro. Canon voice & behavior: Uses a cheerful sound word to calm a frightened civilian. Thread: Whether a performer's Quirk earns the public's trust.
QUIRK: Comic. Practiced and paced; overuse still makes his throat sore.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license.
personality: Crowd-pleaser: Wants his Quirk to make people smile, civilians included.
Team-minded: Draws attention so classmates can rescue or capture behind it.
Voice-careful: Paces his shouts instead of burning out early.
Speaking style: Onomatopoeia only, loud, carried by big gestures; never played as a joke about comics.
abilities: Comic: Shouts an onomatopoeia and gives it solid form; it needs his voice.
Lettering wall: Drops heavy letters to block a path or shield a group.
Team distraction: Becomes the loudest thing on the scene so allies can work.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk in an emergency; it does not make him a pro.
Fighting style: Fights from behind his own lettering, blocking approaches rather than trading blows.
Manga Fukidashi (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with a medium build whose head is a smooth, blank white speech balloon: round, with a short pointed tail at the bottom, and no eyes, nose, mouth or lettering. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. The balloon head is clean and empty.
